landing.title: Adaptive Learner

landing.intro: Adaptive Learner finds the method that fits you best from six research-backed learning approaches, and walks you through a seven-step cycle on every session.

settings.title: Settings
settings.help_intro: Browse and search the in-app glossary. Click any entry for the full article.
settings.mode_solo_desc: Learn for yourself. All features available.
settings.mode_multiplayer_desc: Leaderboards, tournaments, friends. Coming in a future version.
settings.missions_enabled_hint: Show a few achievable goals on the Dashboard each day. Optional - the app works the same without them.
settings.gestures_description: Swipe to navigate in Assessment, Session, and Curriculum.
settings.button_tooltips_description: Show a hover tooltip on icon buttons explaining what they do. Screen-reader labels stay on regardless.
settings.developer_mode_description: Show full technical detail (status code, endpoint, stack trace) in error toasts. A 'DEV' badge appears in the navigation bar while this is on. Off by default; opt-in for debugging.
settings.feedback_intensity_description: How loudly the app celebrates your progress.
settings.feedback_intensity_subtle_desc: Only the correct/wrong colour. No phrases, confetti, or milestone overlays.
settings.feedback_intensity_normal_desc: Animations, praise phrases, and confetti on a perfect score.
settings.feedback_intensity_enthusiastic_desc: Everything, plus milestone overlays and praise on every correct answer.
settings.feedback_intensity_reduced_motion_hint: Reduced-motion is on in your system, so feedback is kept subtle regardless of this setting.
settings.sounds_description: Play short synthesized chimes on correct answers, stars, and milestones. Off by default; sounds never carry information that isn't also shown.
settings.storage_mode_help: Choose where your data lives. Local mode keeps everything in this browser; Server mode talks to the AdaptiveLearner backend.
settings.storage_mode_dexie_hint: Data + API keys live in this browser; AI calls fire direct from the page.
settings.storage_mode_warning: Data is NOT synced between modes. Sync is planned for a future version.
settings.storage_mode_switch_notice: Storage mode saved. Reload the page to switch to the new backend.
settings.active_provider_missing_key: This is your active provider but no API key is stored. AI replies will be skipped until a key is saved.
settings.api_key_external_hint_file: This key is configured in ~/.config/adaptive-learner/secrets.yaml. Edit the file to change it.
settings.api_key_external_hint_env: This key is configured via the ADAPTIVE_LEARNER_{PROVIDER}_API_KEY environment variable.
settings.model_overrides_hint: Leave blank to use the default model for each provider. A non-empty value replaces the default at chat time.
settings.model_picker_placeholder: Select or type a model id
settings.model_picker_error: Could not load models. Check your API key.
settings.model_picker_no_key: Save an API key for this provider to load the available models.
settings.xp_notifications_help: Floating ‘+50 XP’ animation when you earn XP.
settings.badge_notifications_help: Toast when a new badge is earned.
settings.daily_session_goal_help: Sessions per day shown as a progress hint.
settings.reset_progress_help: Permanently delete XP, badges, and streak. Cannot be undone.
settings.reset_confirm_second: Click once more to delete forever

voice.tts_enabled_help: Reads AI responses aloud when you click the speaker icon.
voice.auto_play_help: Speak each AI response automatically (default off).
voice.tts_voice_help: Default uses the closest match for your project language.
voice.stt_enabled_help: Dictate your replies via the browser's speech recognition.
voice.stt_lang_help: Leave empty to use the project / UI language. Format: BCP-47 (e.g. en-US, es-ES).
voice.pronunciation_enabled_help: Surfaces a 'Pronunciation Practice' button on language-learning project dashboards.

about.identity_explainer: This file is auto-managed by Adaptive Learner. It lets the app recover your user identity after a browser data wipe. Do not edit it manually.

donations.liberapay_desc: Recurring donations. Open-source, no fees taken by the platform.
donations.github_desc: Sponsor via your existing GitHub account.

backup.section_help: Export everything in your account as a JSON file. API keys are NOT included; you will need to re-enter them after a restore.
backup.invalid_format: This file is not a valid Adaptive Learner backup.
backup.comparison_help: Restore will merge: new records inserted, mutable records updated only if the backup is newer, history rows kept as-is. Nothing is deleted. API keys are ignored.
backup.reminder_overdue: It has been more than {{days}} days since your last backup.
backup.auto_help: Automatically back up after every 10 completed sessions or once a week.
backup.auto_none: No auto-backups yet. The first one runs after 10 sessions or 7 days.
backup.storage_pressure: Browser storage is almost full ({{pct}}% of quota). Export a manual backup now.
backup.compare_help: Pick two backup files (or one file plus the current state) to see what's changed between them. No data is modified — comparison is read-only.
backup.compare_no_changes: The two backups are identical — no differences detected.
backup.compare_high_volume_hint: High-volume table — record-level previews shown abbreviated.
backup.auto_compare_missing: Auto-backup is no longer available — it was rotated out.
